checks.finding: Met2015.300.179 is addressed to 谷文二 (Tani Bunji), not 谷文晁 (Tani Buncho); original Japanese title was wrong and requires a separately versioned fact correction.

Osaka University KAKENHI report explicitly treats this exact 1833 farewell work as an example of late-Edo literati farewell painting in a lineage of ideal and real. No evidence for artist's inner sorrow or real landscape location.
Existing zero emotion tags justified; farewell topic not sufficient to attribute sorrow.
New original Japanese interpretation distinguishes recipient and father, identifies visible inscription/landscape but does not invent translation.
